title: In-Q-Tel portfolio & CIA/IC-venture surveillance-&-data-stack lineage
source: Public record: In-Q-Tel disclosed portfolio/history; corporate acquisition records (Google/Keyhole 2004; Google/Mandiant 2022); press + IQT team/portfolio pages. Structural overlay; edges graded in notes. Surveillance-cluster webbing (#218). In-Q-Tel->Palantir also carried in spec-palantir-surveillance.json.

edges.notes: In-Q-Tel (est. 1999) is the CIA's not-for-profit strategic-investment arm - the mechanism that identifies + seeds dual-use commercial tech into the Agency (fact).
IQT now serves the broader Intelligence Community + partners (NGA, DIA, DHS, and others) - not just the CIA (fact).
In-Q-Tel funded Keyhole Inc. (~2003), the geospatial-imaging startup (fact).
In-Q-Tel (with Google Ventures) was an early investor in Recorded Future (threat-intel / OSINT temporal analytics) (fact).
Recorded Future supplies threat-intel/OSINT to IC + gov customers - the analytics layer on public + dark-web data (fact).
In-Q-Tel was an early investor in FireEye (later Mandiant) (fact).
Google acquired Keyhole in 2004; its tech became Google Earth / Maps (fact).
Google acquired Mandiant in 2022 (~$5.4B), folding it into Google Cloud security (fact).
IQT seed investment in Palantir (~2004-05); the CIA was Palantir's primary early customer for years - the flagship IQT surveillance/data-fusion bet (fact; amounts undisclosed).
The CIA was Palantir's anchor early customer (Gotham) - the seed-to-customer pipeline IQT is designed to create (fact).
IQT invested in Databricks (~2016), the lakehouse/AI data-platform - data-fusion substrate for IC analytics (fact).
IQT-backed big-data (Hadoop) platform - enterprise/IC data lakes; a billion-dollar IQT outcome (fact).
IQT invested in 10gen/MongoDB - document database widely used across gov data systems (an IQT 'unicorn' exit) (fact).
IQT relationship with Anduril (defense autonomy/sensing/counter-UAS; Luckey/Founders-Fund lineage) - ties the IQT web to the Palantir/Thiel defense cluster (fact; terms undisclosed).
IQT-backed synthetic-biology platform - the biosecurity/biodata leg of the portfolio (fact).
Palantir<->Databricks product partnership (Foundry/AIP + lakehouse interop) - two IQT-lineage data platforms interoperating (fact).

IQT-backed Dataminr - real-time alerting off the Twitter/X firehose + other public feeds; ACLU/press documented use for protest/activity monitoring by police + agencies (fact of investment + use; scope contested).
Dataminr's 'First Alert' sells real-time social-media event detection to government/public-safety customers - the social-media-monitoring node of the IC-venture web (fact).
IQT-backed Orbital Insight - geospatial AI extracting patterns (cars, ships, construction) from satellite imagery at scale (fact).
Commercial geoint feeding NGA/defense analysis - the AI layer atop the Keyhole-lineage imagery world (fact).
IQT-backed HawkEye 360 - smallsat constellations geolocating RF emissions (ships going dark, jamming, comms) - space-based signals intelligence as a service (fact).
RF-geolocation data sold to NGA/defense/IC - commercial SIGINT-adjacent geoint (fact).
Commercial-space geoint peers (imagery + RF) increasingly integrated for IC tasking - wires the IQT web to the space-imaging block (#186) (fact of sector).
IQT-backed Primer - NLP/generative-AI for IC document + open-source analysis (fact).
IQT-backed Shield AI - autonomy software (Hivemind) for GPS/comms-denied drone operations (fact).
Defense-autonomy peers in the IQT/Founders-Fund-adjacent cluster (fact of sector).
IQT-backed Fivecast - OSINT/social-media risk analytics used by IC + law enforcement (fact).
IQT-backed Cylance - AI endpoint security (later acquired by BlackBerry) (fact).
IQT was an early investor in D-Wave (quantum annealing) - the IC's hedge on quantum optimization/compute (fact).
D-Wave pioneered commercial quantum annealers - wires the IQT web to the quantum tracker's hardware landscape (fact).
IQT-backed Sonitus - near-ear/in-mouth covert comms hardware for operators (fact); the wearable-comms leg of the portfolio.

note: In-Q-Tel (IQT) is the CIA/Intelligence-Community's not-for-profit strategic investor (est. 1999); it does NOT disclose funding amounts/dates, so edges are graded on the PUBLIC record of an IQT relationship, not deal terms. IQT reports ~494 portfolio companies (Aug 2026); this block maps a representative surveillance/data/geoint subset. Edges are STRUCTURAL (cia_seed / gov_contract / corporate_lineage) - an IQT tie is a capability/adoption signal, NOT evidence of witting espionage by the company.
